item.description:

Event Format: Panel Discussion Venue: Stage B, Metro Toronto Convention Centre Presented by Kling AI, this panel explores how AI video is redefining the way cinematic stories are imagined, developed, and produced. Featuring an early look at Kling AI’s newest video model, the conversation brings together filmmakers and technology leaders to discuss how AI video can carry a creative vision from concept through production—with the quality, consistency, and control required for professional storytelling. Open to all TIFF Market Pass Holders. RSVP is encouraged but not required.
Hosted by Jiaqi Liu

item.description:

Guided by reflective questions, participants engage in practices such as origami with washi, drawing, dyeing, and writing, using the lotus as a shared symbol of transformation and resilience across cultures. The workshops foster an inclusive, supportive environment, particularly for those who feel marginalized or disconnected. The series culminates in a collaborative public floral installation in the library, sharing participants’ work with the wider community. Led by artists "Being~inbetween" The workshops are open to youth, ages 13-17, and require no prior artistic experience.
